entities.name: Caizi jiaren
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: Caizi jiaren is a genre of Chinese fiction typically involving a romance between a young scholar and a beautiful girl. The genre was highly popular during the late Ming dynasty and early Qing dynasty.
